name: press-to-fix
description: Long press any element of your React Native app in the iOS simulator, say what is wrong, and the report lands in this Codex session with the file, line and a screenshot.

interface.shortDescription: Fix React Native UI by long pressing it in the iOS simulator
interface.longDescription: Wrap your React Native app in <FixHost> from react-native-press-to-fix. Long press any element in the iOS simulator and type what is wrong: the report reaches this Codex session with the JSX file and line, the components around it and a screenshot. Fast Refresh shows the fix in seconds.
